name: kittens-saved
description: Counts the kittens you save by doing the work instead of punting it, and gates the agent's escape hatch: you may only stop cleanly when nothing of yours is left unsaved. A TWO-TIER, evidence-gated Stop hook that reads THIS turn's message (bounded-wait, so the current turn not the previous) with context-aware matching that ignores code/quotes/blockquotes: a high-confidence DENYLIST fires an act-now nudge (grow it with the human-gated `blame` grammar), and a soft WARNLIST fires a gentle [i] reminder carrying a reason and an escape-condition, capped per session (grow it with `warn`). Plus a startup primer with the Zen of Kittens, a JSONL ledger, ops commands (status/stats/doctor/config), and a statusline segment.

scope.title: Tally scope
scope.description: Whether the statusline and the default `/kittens count` show kittens saved in this session only, or across all sessions. One of: session, all.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Set to false to silence the Stop-hook reminder and the statusline segment everywhere. Per-session control is /kittens toggle off.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: When true, the hooks echo the content they inject to stderr, prefixed [kittens-saved-debug], so you can see the reminder in the transcript / claude --debug without decoding the hook JSON.

strip_quotes.title: Strip quotes before matching
strip_quotes.description: When true (default), the Stop-hook denylist ignores phrases inside double-quoted spans (as well as code and blockquotes), so a quoted meta-mention of a tell does not trip it. Set false to match quoted spans too.

warn_repeat.title: Warn repeat cap
warn_repeat.description: How many times a single warnlist matcher may fire per session before it goes quiet: 0 disables the soft warn tier, 1 is once-only, 2 (default) reinforces once. Keeps the [i] reminders gentle rather than naggy.
